cues.en: Now, the last condition that we are going to look at is going to be right left condition.
So here again we have an AVL tree like this.
Now if I want to insert eight over here it's obvious that eight is greater than 70.
It will continue to the right subtree and it is greater than 75.
It's going to continue to right subtree.
Now when it comes to the 85 it is less than 85.
So this means that it's going to be inserted as a left child of 85 over here.
Now after doing so, the next thing that we are going to do we need to find out the this balance node.
So in this case the this balance node is going to be 75.
So after finding the this balance node we are going to find the condition.
So the condition is going to be right and left condition.
So so after doing so here as you can see the condition says that right left condition.
So this means that first we are going to do the right rotation on the right child.
Then we are going to do the left rotation.
So the right child of this balanced node is 85.
So this means that on 85 we are going to do the right rotation.
So when we do the right rotation on 85, 85 will become the right child of the 80, and 80 will become
the right child of 75.
So it's going to be something like this.
Now, after finding this, if you look at this condition, it's going to become the right right condition.
So in case of right right condition we are doing the left rotation on this balance node.
So when we do the left rotation 75 will become the left child of 80.
And 80 will become the right child of 70.
So it's going to be something like this.
So as you can see in case of right left condition first we are doing right rotation on the right child.
Then we are doing the left rotation on the disbalance node.
So here again we are going to use the left and right methods that we have created in our previous lectures.
So if you want to learn more about how that methods work, you can go back and check the left lift and
left right conditions where we have created that methods there.
So I have not put them over here to avoid the repetition.
But when we are going to create the insert method itself, we are going to use that method.
So hopefully everything is clear.
